purpose: Compact long-term knowledge distilled from Framework experience.

principles: Write from a clean event dossier rather than raw feed fragments.
Separate writing technique learning from article-content memory.
Require leads to establish the central verified fact before context or commentary.
Repair repeated phrasing and placeholder/process language before editor review.
Generate headlines from story identity and dossier facts, not publisher headline structure.
Prefer actor + action + consequence when the dossier supports all three elements.
Repair headline-only failures without rewriting the full article body.
Reject word salad, truncation, and headline-body mismatch as repairable states before final block.
Treat most language, grammar, transition, headline, attribution, and formatting failures as repairable.
Only evidence gaps, mixed topics, fabricated facts, and unresolved contradictions should return to dossier or writer.
Every rejection should produce a full issue list, repair plan, resubmission state, and learning signal.
Weight sources by availability, latency, source type, originality, correction behavior, and evidence tier.
Isolate source failures by provider and URL before treating feed health as an aggregate problem.
Promote primary-source evidence over secondary reporting when both are available.

observedKeys: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation|news.google.com

principles: Retain reusable knowledge, not every raw experience.
Classify memory into working, episodic, semantic, skill, and identity layers.
Do not compact raw records until active repairs, public visibility, audit needs, and lesson extraction are complete.
